notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648604/bc0b7c08b9e3c86fe5832900f10d2a944f54313c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone. 

New small patch today to address some minor issues and improvements to the game : [/p][p]
-added a small VFX effect when digging[/p][p]-fixed a protagonist's voice volume who was too low. Yoirgl[/p]

notes.title: 💥 JOIN THE BETA, YA SCRUFFY STONE-LOVER 💥
notes.content:
Oi, you! Yeah, you with the pickaxe and no sense of self-preservation!

We’re calling all shovel-swingers, grappling-hook-gliders, and beer-guzzling brutes to join the [b]OFFICIAL BETA[/b] of [i]Only DWARVES DIG Proper HOLES[/i]! 🍻

[b]What’s in it for you, you ask?[/b]  
We’ll give you the game.  
[b]For free.[/b]  
Yes. Like, actually free. No gold coins. No IOUs. Just glorious dwarven gameplay shoved right into your Steam library.

All we ask in return?  
[b]Your HONEST feedback.[/b]  
Tell us what made you laugh, cry, or scream into your mining helmet. We promise to listen (unless it's about nerfing the grappling hook—never).

But first, you need to [b] [url=https://discord.gg/yxFm2gYDMW]JOIN OUR DISCORD[/url] and ask for your beta key[/b].  
We’ll hand it over like a frothy pint at the tavern—no questions asked (okay maybe one or two).

---

[b][u]🪓 JOIN OUR DISCORD 🪓[/u][/b]  
Click here, beardling 👉 [url=https://discord.gg/yxFm2gYDMW]Discord[/url]

Meet other testers. Request your beta key. Share your most explosive hole-digging fails. Post memes. Argue about whether dwarves should wear pants. All the good stuff.

---

[b]⛏️ So what do you need?[/b]
[list]
[*] A VR headset  
[*] A sense of adventure  
[*] A love for digging  
[*] And at least 1 (one) working eye to spot danger or treasure (optional, but preferred)  
[/list]

---

[b]The beta is limited,[/b] so grab your spot faster than a goblin grabs unguarded loot.  
We’ll see you in the tunnels, tester. Just remember:

[quote][b]DIG DEEP. DRINK BEER. REPORT BUGS.[/b][/quote]

—The Devs  
[i](Still stuck in a hole. Send help.)[/i]

notes.title: Patch notes 17/06/25
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648604/bc0b7c08b9e3c86fe5832900f10d2a944f54313c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]New update : 

-renamed "energy" into "beer" on the upgrade panel[/p][p]-increased the starting beer level by 50%[/p][p]-reorganized the upgrade panel to have Save and Menu buttons at the top[/p][p]-reworked the movement system to try and limit the stuttering when using the smooth rotation setting[/p][p]-introduction of a light management system that should limit the inconvenience of having torches close-by turning off. [/p][p]-fixed a bug that caused the "unmovable rock" voice-line to trigger when digging normally, particularly in the tutorial. [/p]
